-- svc/encore.service.ts --
import { Service } from "encore.dev/service";

export default new Service("svc");

-- svc/db.ts --
import { MongoDatabase } from "encore.dev/storage/mongodb";

// Define a MongoDB database
export const db = new MongoDatabase("urls");

-- other/encore.service.ts --
import { Service } from "encore.dev/service";

export default new Service("other");

-- other/stats.ts --
import { MongoDatabase } from "encore.dev/storage/mongodb";

// Reference the database from a different service using .named()
const db = MongoDatabase.named("urls");

export async function count(): Promise<number> {
  return db.collection("urls").countDocuments({});
}

-- package.json --
{
  "name": "mongodb-named-test",
  "type": "module",
  "dependencies": {
    "encore.dev": "^1.35.0"
  }
}
